status.en: 192 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 29% more than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Balochistan.
status.nb: 192 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 29 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Belutsjistan.

summary.en: Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security forces along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants in Balochistan. Pakistan has suspended trade at two Iran border crossings amid violence and smuggling concerns, while a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing. The country is moving to ratify a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey that expands security cooperation beyond bilateral frameworks, and the United Nations warns that Afghanistan is one step away from famine. Battle-related deaths were recorded at 1,794 in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Talibanstyrker skjøt mot pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker langs Kurram-grensen, og drepte en pakistansk offiser og flere militante i Balochistan. Pakistan har stanset handel ved to grenseoverganger mot Iran på grunn av vold og bekymringer om smugling, mens en tvist om Zangali-kontrollpost forstyrrer driften ved Torkham-overgangen. Landet er i ferd med å ratifisere en forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia som utvider sikkerhetssamarbeidet utover bilaterale rammer, og FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød. Dødsfall i kamper ble registrert til 1 794 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
